AvailableCapacity.description: Number of instances of this type that can still be created in the dedicated host cluster.

AvailableInstanceTypes.description: Supported instance types and the remaining number of instances that can be created for each type in this dedicated host cluster.

AvailableMemory.description: Total remaining available memory in this dedicated host cluster, measured in GiB.

AvailableVcpus.description: Total remaining available vCPU count in this dedicated host cluster.

LocalVolumeCapacities.description: Available and total capacity of each type of local disk in this dedicated host cluster.

TotalMemory.description: Total memory of this dedicated host cluster, measured in GiB.

TotalVcpus.description: Total vCPU count of this dedicated host cluster.

AvailableSize.description: Remaining available capacity of this type of local disk, measured in GiB.

TotalSize.description: Total capacity of this type of local disk, measured in GiB.

description: The dedicated host cluster is a logical collection at the availability zone level. You can use dedicated host clusters to group and manage dedicated hosts, or create instances in a specified cluster.

CreatedAt.description: Creation time of the dedicated host cluster.

DedicatedHostClusterCapacity.description: Capacity information of the dedicated host cluster, including available memory, available vCPU, supported instance types, and more.

DedicatedHostClusterId.description: ID of the dedicated host cluster.

DedicatedHostClusterName.description: Name of the dedicated host cluster. Length limit: 1–128 characters. Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.), and must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character.

DedicatedHostIds.description: List of IDs for all dedicated hosts contained in this dedicated host cluster.

Description.description: Description of the dedicated host cluster. Length limit: 0–256 characters.

UpdatedAt.description: Last update time of the dedicated host cluster.

ZoneId.description: Availability zone ID to which the dedicated host cluster belongs. Cannot be modified after creation.
